key_findings: CY-09 relieved LPS- and formalin-induced inflammatory pain, reduced NLRP3/caspase-1/NF-kB, cytokines, M1 polarization and TRPA1/Ca2+.
The TRPA1 agonist AITC reversed CY-09 analgesia, implicating TRPA1 in its effect.
